editorial_thesis: The strongest new signal is not another model launch: agent work is becoming a managed operating surface, personal context is becoming portable infrastructure, and evaluation quality now depends on testing the harness around the model.

topic_groups.title: Agent Runtime Release Surface
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh September 4 GitHub releases add long-horizon model capability, multi-root sessions, merge automation, and privacy-safe analytics; this is a concrete workflow shift rather than yesterday’s deprecation notice.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra is generally available in GitHub Copilot
sources.why_selected: GitHub positions the model around planning, execution, diagnosis, and independent validation.
sources.usefulness: Benchmark it on bounded repository tasks and inspect cost per verified outcome.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — August 31
sources.why_selected: The weekly bundle connects model choice with content exclusions, Agent Merge, multi-root workspaces, and session organization.
sources.usefulness: Treat the IDE as an agent control plane: scope context, sessions, and merge permissions together.

sources.title: New API endpoint provides privacy-safe star history data
sources.why_selected: It replaces identity-exposing stargazer scraping with aggregate historical counts.
sources.usefulness: Restore repository trend analytics without retaining user-level engagement data.

sources.title: Supported GitHub Copilot models
sources.why_selected: The model catalog is the operational reference for availability, plans, and migration decisions.
sources.usefulness: Maintain a small compatibility matrix instead of hard-coding one provider default.

topic_groups.title: Personal Context + Access
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Coverage has underweighted user-facing context and collaboration infrastructure. September Android features and Microsoft’s model-diverse local-to-cloud stack show where agent utility meets permissions and accessibility.

sources.title: September Android Drop
sources.why_selected: Remembered items, Guided vision, and shared Keep notes turn ambient context into user-controlled utility.
sources.usefulness: Design memory features around explicit capture, retrieval, correction, and safety boundaries.

sources.title: Microsoft Build 2026: Be yourself at work
sources.why_selected: Microsoft frames Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, local sandboxing, and multi-model choice as one governed stack.
sources.usefulness: Use the model/context/runtime split as a reference architecture for client discovery.

sources.title: Announcing OpenAI DevDay 2026
sources.why_selected: The September 29 event is a near-term primary-source checkpoint for API and agent platform changes.
sources.usefulness: Reserve a review slot; update Buildn assumptions only from shipped announcements.

sources.title: Google AI updates from August 2026
sources.why_selected: The roundup identifies Gemini 3.7 Flash as a workhorse model for coding and agents.
sources.usefulness: Compare workhorse-model positioning against long-horizon specialist models.

topic_groups.title: Evaluation Harness Integrity
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A current arXiv scan exposes a practical gap: agent reliability, monitorability, and benchmark scores can change with state, serving adapters, and interface design even when model weights do not.

sources.title: arXiv cs.AI new submissions — 4 September 2026
sources.why_selected: New work reports stale-plan failures, harness attacks, monitorability gaps, and large serving-adapter score shifts.
sources.usefulness: Test the whole agent harness: state freshness, tools, serving, monitors, and abstention.

sources.title: Self-Host Weekly — 4 September 2026
sources.why_selected: The issue records SourceHut’s LLM-code policy, Home Assistant 2026.9, Tailcat, and a Plex security update.
sources.usefulness: Keep a pragmatic local-first lane: provenance rules, patch cadence, and reversible infrastructure.

sources.title: Home Assistant 2026.9
sources.why_selected: The release improves cloud-login visibility, security alerts, activity entries, and Matter support.
sources.usefulness: Borrow clearer activity and alert surfaces for agent actions in Buildn OS.

sources.title: Changes to SourceHut’s terms regarding LLMs
sources.why_selected: It is a concrete governance response to low-provenance generated contributions.
sources.usefulness: Make contribution provenance and human review explicit in client workflows.
